## Idea
A marketplace for niche 3D-printable widgets.

## Evidence of Pain
Several hobbyist forums show recurring requests for a central place to buy/sell
one-off widget designs; no dedicated marketplace exists today.

## Constraints
Solo maintainer, evenings/weekends only.

## Out of Scope
Physical fulfillment/shipping — digital files only, buyer prints locally.

## What Would Convince You: Project
At least three independent forum threads confirming willingness to pay for a
curated widget file, plus one competitor teardown showing no direct overlap.

## Decision Rights
AI may pick the tech stack and MVP feature cut without asking.
